blocks.text: PORTLAND, Oregon— Deni Avdija scored 33 points to lead the Portland Trail Blazers to a 116-111 win over the San Antonio Spurs in both teams’ third NBA Cup matchup of the group stage on Wednesday. Damian Lillard added 29 points for the Blazers (12-6) to go along with 16 from Sidy Cissoko. Jrue Holiday had 11 points off the bench while Scoot Henderson had 10.
